        br                      next2

        ldc.r4          float32(0xBF800000)

        ble.s                   next3
        br                      fail
next3:
        ldc.r4          float32(0x3F800000)
        ldc.r4          float32(0x3F800000)
        ble.s                   next4
        br                      fail
next4:
        ldc.r4          float32(0x3F800000)
        ldc.r4          float32(0xBF800000)
        ble                   fail
        br                      next5
next5:
        ldc.r4          float32(0xBF800000)
        ldc.r4          float32(0x3F800000)
        ble.un.s        next6
        br                      fail
next6:
        ldc.r4          float32(0x3F800000)
        ldc.r4          float32(0x3F800000)
        ble.un.s        next7
        br                      fail
next7:
        ldc.r4          float32(0x3F800000)
        ldc.r4          float32(0xBF800000)
        ble.un.s        fail
        br                      next8
next8:
        ldc.r4          float32(0x7FC00000)
        ldc.r4          float32(0x7FC00000)
        ble.un.s        next9
        br                      fail
next9:
        ldc.r4          float32(0x7FC00000)
        ldc.r4          float32(0x3F800000)
        ble.un.s        next10
        br                      fail
next10:
        ldc.r4          float32(0xBF800000)
        ldc.r4          float32(0x7FC00000)
        ble.un.s        pass
        br                      fail

pass:
        ldc.i4 100
        br                      end
fail:
        ldc.i4          0x0
        br                      end
end:
        ret
}
